_about: The page set and hub content for this vendor: every dataset the site documents, grouped as the hub lists it, with its families. Rendered by gridflow-build.
name: NESO Data Portal
intro: NESO’s open-data portal, a CKAN file catalogue. gridflow reads three of its files: the GB generation mix since 2009, the embedded wind and solar forecast, and daily wind availability per BM unit.
facts: GB electricity, from the system operator
Half-hourly for the generation mix and the embedded forecast; daily per BM unit for wind availability

landing.desc: System operator files: the GB generation mix since 2009, embedded forecasts
landing.fact: current file only, no API key
